title: validateApp requires owner (libs/shared-contracts, inlined; no registry release)
Pass owner from package.json team in core-shell, billing, reports

summary: validateApp (libs/shared-contracts, the shared config lib; no libs/config exists) now throws if owner missing/empty. core-shell/billing/reports pass owner = package.json team (platform/payments/insights), hardcoded literals. Lib is inlined at build time and lives in the monorepo, so no registry release/version bump needed (platform-kit untouched). All 3 apps built locally; PR #1 CI+CD green.
